name: Whipvine Arrow deals Nature damage and roots its target natively (#3630)
contract: Original Whipvine Arrow 806342 deals Nature damage and roots its target. Advantage 804329 gates the
normal cast; its range is five to thirty yards. The original ranged damage class uses ranged hit despite
the Nature school, so this fixture supplies ranged hit and places the enemy fifteen yards away.
EquippedItemClass -1 does not require a weapon. The native root and damage effects must both land.
Separate ranger-whipvine-advantage-targets-3630 and one/five-stack boundary scenarios cover additional
targets; this case verifies one ordinary cast against one enemy.
